narrativeProgression.description: The Interviewee describes the company's strategy of demanding pay cuts and threatening workers with job losses if they don't comply.
He emphasizes the length of the dispute (2.5 months) and the company's clear intention to starve out the workers.
The Interviewee draws parallels between the labor dispute and the Occupy Wall Street movement, noting a global attack on workers' rights.
He expresses optimism about the solidarity and strength of unions like Unite and the Teamsters.
The Interviewee pledges support from Teamsters in the US to the UK workers and expresses readiness to take action if needed.
He discusses the Occupy Wall Street movement and how it has inspired unions and protesters to join forces.
The Interviewee elaborates on the growing momentum of the Occupy movement and its spread to other countries like Australia.
